relationships.subject: Mithramycin A
relationships.evidence_quote: Mithramycin reversed oxaliplatin-induced cold hypersensitivity and oxaliplatin-induced TRPM8 overexpression in dorsal root ganglion (DRG).

relationships.subject: Oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: DRG derived from these mice had an increase (∼4 fold) in TRPM8 mRNA

relationships.subject: Mithramycin A
relationships.evidence_quote: DRG derived from mice tested with oxaliplatin followed by MTM rescue showed reversal of TRPM8 mRNA overexpression to baseline levels

relationships.subject: Sp4
relationships.evidence_quote: Sp1 and Sp4 are drivers of TRPV1 promoter activity and TRPV1 expression in DRG neurons

relationships.subject: Mithramycin A
relationships.evidence_quote: Mithramycin, a Sp1-family transcription inhibitor, was shown to block TRPV1 expression in nociceptors.

key_findings: Mithramycin A reversed CFA-induced inflammatory heat hyperalgesia and cisplatin- and oxaliplatin-induced hypersensitivity in mice, more efficaciously in males.
MTM normalized oxaliplatin-induced TRPM8 overexpression in DRG but did not rescue IENF loss.
